description: This file defines React components for managing a library menu in a UI, including dropdown menus, dialogs, and actions related to library items such as import, export, publish, and remove.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Filters library items to include only those with IDs in selectedItems.

methods.name: renderRemoveLibAlert
methods.description: Renders a confirmation dialog for removing items from the library or resetting the library.

methods.name: renderPublishSuccess
methods.description: Renders a dialog indicating successful publishing of a library item.

methods.name: onPublishLibSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful publishing of a library item, updating its status and library state.

methods.name: onLibraryImport
methods.description: Handles importing a library file, updating the library state.

methods.name: onLibraryExport
methods.description: Handles exporting selected or all library items as JSON.

methods.name: renderLibraryMenu
methods.description: Renders the dropdown menu with options for library actions.

methods.name: removeFromLibrary
methods.description: Removes selected items from the library and updates cache.

methods.name: resetLibrary
methods.description: Resets the library to an empty state and clears cache.
